torch-int8.title: PyTorch INT8 dynamic quantization (CPU, no export)
torch-int8.reason: real INT8 dynamic quantization of the merged model without an export step; artifact is runtime-only (in-memory), openly labelled as such

hf-fp32.title: CPU fp32 HuggingFace fallback (no quantization)
hf-fp32.reason: final fallback: runnable but slow; 4-bit speed-up goes to Limitations

fallback_chain_note: try in order; a route that is missing or fails is recorded as not_run/blocked with the real error. ONNX is marked conditional because Idefics3 export support is unverified.

steps.title: Merge LoRA adapter into a standalone fp32 CPU checkpoint
acceptance: report status=completed with adapter + base hashes
merged dir has model.safetensors + config + processor/tokenizer files
no remaining lora_* modules in the merged checkpoint config
model.safetensors size is ~2x the bf16 base weight size (fp32 merge)
steps.on_failure: stop; report blocker; never fabricate a merged artifact
steps.blocking_scope_note: adapters/merged is outside this prep task's write scope; the Lead must confirm the T14 write scope before execution

steps.title: Merge equivalence: base+adapter vs merged must generate identical boxes
acceptance: 5 fixed synthetic_eval samples produce byte-identical output_text
parse_rate 1.0 on those 5 samples
any mismatch is reported as merge_failed, not averaged away
steps.on_failure: do not deploy the merged model; investigate dtype/merge target mismatch

steps.title: GGUF Q4_K_M export smoke (preferred route)
acceptance: convert_hf_to_gguf.py produced an F16 GGUF and a *mmproj*.gguf
llama-quantize produced a Q4_K_M GGUF
llama-mtmd-cli on one fixed image emits 4 parseable box numbers
file sizes and sha256 recorded in results/deploy_quantize_gguf.json
steps.on_failure: capture the exact error, then fall through to S4 (ONNX) or S5 (torch INT8)
steps.setup_note: first 10 minutes are a tool/protocol smoke (convert --help, mmproj naming, mtmd-cli flags) because llama.cpp CLI names drift between releases

steps.title: ONNX export + dynamic quantization (conditional fallback)
acceptance: optimum-cli export onnx succeeds for Idefics3 (else route recorded blocked)
quantize_dynamic halves or better the decoder artifact size
onnxruntime CPU session loads the quantized graph
steps.on_failure: record blocked_tool_missing / unsupported_architecture and fall through to S5
steps.scientific_note: the ONNX files already present under models/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct/onnx are the upstream BASE model (no project LoRA); they must not be presented as our quantized model

steps.title: PyTorch INT8 dynamic quantization (export-free fallback)
acceptance: quantize_dynamic on the text decoder succeeds and generate() returns a parseable box
runtime label recorded as int8-dynamic-cpu (in-memory artifact, no file)
steps.on_failure: fall through to S6 CPU fp32; report quantization as not achieved

steps.title: CPU latency benchmark: merged fp32 (50 images, 5 warmups)
acceptance: n=50, warmup=5, deterministic id digest
mean/median/p95/p99/min/max + peak RSS recorded
parse_rate and diagnostic accuracy recorded (official metrics remain eval-closer's)
steps.on_failure: record not_run with the error; no invented latency numbers

steps.title: CPU latency benchmark: quantized and/or GGUF engine on the same 50 ids
acceptance: same selected_ids digest as S6 so the CPU/quantized columns are comparable
per-run backend version and artifact sha256 recorded
steps.on_failure: benchmark whatever quantized engine actually exists; list the missing route as not_run

steps.title: GPU bf16 baseline latency (requires Lead GPU lease)
acceptance: lease id recorded; nvidia-smi before/after; abort if >7500 MiB or a competing task appears
same 50 ids as S6/S7 for a fair Table 3 row
steps.on_failure: skip the GPU column; never report an unmeasured number
steps.gating_note: blocked until the Lead announces the current evaluation lease is released

steps.title: Gradio demo: install, launch, real API round-trip, screenshot evidence
acceptance: gradio installed (needs approval) and server answers HTTP 200
gradio_client round-trip on a real image returns an annotated image and a box string
results/deploy_demo_smoke.json + saved annotated PNG under demo/artifacts/
screenshot/browser confirmation recorded by the Lead (agent cannot claim a human-visible UI without it)
steps.on_failure: fallback: CLI predictor script + annotated PNG (still honest, but G7 demo part not passed)
steps.gating_note: requires `python -m pip install gradio` approval (network download)

steps.title: Hand-off document for independent deployment evaluation
acceptance: artifact paths + sha256 + exact inference command + prompt id p1 + image_seq_len 36 documented
eval-closer can rerun 1000-image sets without reading deploy code
official +量化 metrics are produced by eval-closer, not by deploy code
steps.on_failure: block G7; paper must mark deployment row not_run

risks.mitigation: 10-minute convert smoke first; record exact error; fall back to ONNX then torch-int8 then CPU fp32

risks.risk: no llama.cpp binaries / cmake / MSVC compiler on the machine
risks.mitigation: unpack a prebuilt Windows CPU release (needs approval) or skip GGUF; do not silently claim 4-bit

risks.risk: ONNX export of Idefics3 via optimum fails under transformers 5.19
risks.mitigation: record blocked status; use torch INT8 dynamic quantization (real quantization, no export) as the next fallback

risks.risk: the pre-existing ONNX files are the BASE model without our LoRA and could be mistaken for the deployed model
risks.mitigation: inventory marks carries_project_lora=false; quantize route refuses to use them for Table rows

risks.risk: CPU fp32 is NOT faster than the GPU bf16 baseline (prior CPU ~1.78-1.95 s/img vs measured GPU ~1.33 s/img)

risks.mitigation: report honestly as a negative result; 4-bit reduces size and enables CPU-only execution; do not fake a speed-up

risks.risk: gradio is missing and installing it needs a network download/approval
risks.mitigation: request approval; meanwhile deliver CLI predictor + annotated PNG fallback; never present an unlaunched UI as working

risks.risk: adapters/merged is outside the current prep write scope

risks.mitigation: label every artifact 'provisional sft_v1 seed42'; re-merge if the Lead freezes a different adapter

risks.risk: quantized CPU benchmark competes for CPU with an in-flight GPU evaluation driver
risks.mitigation: wait for the Lead's explicit 'evaluation finished' message before any model load or 50-image benchmark
